payload.name: PreservePriorFactsOnMemoryUpdate
payload.description: When updating an existing memory with new details about the same subject, preserve previously stored facts unless directly contradicted by the new evidence.
content: During UPDATE operations on an existing memory, merge the new information into the existing content instead of replacing the whole memory. Keep all prior facts that are not explicitly contradicted by the new message. If a fact is genuinely contradicted, remove only that fact and update it with the corrected value; retain all other existing facts.

solves: When an UPDATE rewrites an existing memory using only the newest message's details, earlier true facts about the same subject can be silently dropped. The reusable rule is to treat memory updates as merges: preserve prior facts unless directly contradicted by new evidence, and replace or remove only the superseded portion. This applies whenever a later message enriches or corrects an already-stored profile, preference, or entity memory.
